name: Risen In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are united with Christ in His death and resurrection, symbolized through baptism, which signifies being buried and raised to walk in newness of life (Romans 6:4; Colossians 2:12). This union means that the life Christians now live is empowered by Christ living within them, sustained by faith in the Son of God who gave Himself for us (Galatians 2:20). The indwelling Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead also gives life to our mortal bodies, confirming the transformative power of resurrection in the believer's daily walk (Romans 8:11). Consequently, believers are considered dead to sin and their old selves, with their true life hidden and secured in Christ (Colossians 3:3).
